findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "electricity-market" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: electricity-market_demand-profile-analyze · Private data: electricity-market_price-series-normalize, electricity-market_price-compare, electricity-market_demand-profile-analyze, electricity-market_carbon-intensity-track, electricity-market_bill-tariff-reconcile, electricity-market_peak-demand-charge-calculate, electricity-market_energy-price-volatility-analyze, electricity-market_renewable-generation-forecast, electricity-market_grid-outage-public-data-analyze, electricity-market_exposure-report, contact_us · Public sink: contact_us.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: electricity-market_demand-profile-analyze · Private data: electricity-market_price-series-normalize, electricity-market_price-compare, electricity-market_demand-profile-analyze, electricity-market_carbon-intensity-track, electricity-market_bill-tariff-reconcile, electricity-market_peak-demand-charge-calculate, electricity-market_energy-price-volatility-analyze, electricity-market_renewable-generation-forecast, electricity-market_grid-outage-public-data-analyze, electricity-market_exposure-report, contact_us · Public sink: contact_us

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
